verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs say users can review their prompts, delete Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity at any time, which covers the core of retention and deletion control. Related docs also describe limits on human review and model-training use of chats, plus an opt-in for using audio and Live data for training. missing for 10: configurable auto-delete retention periods, granular deletion of individual chats/uploaded files/memory, independent or hands-on corroboration.
